subject: Workplace Skills
title: The Gatekeeper Effect
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Gatekeeper Effect usable.

hook.text: Executive assistants are often the most connected people in a company. They control calendar access.

buildup.text: Gatekeepers filter who gets attention, what gets prioritized, and which information reaches leaders.

discovery.text: Treating gatekeepers well is not politics. It's recognizing their genuine influence on outcomes.

twist.text: People who bypass gatekeepers disrespectfully create enemies in the most strategic positions.

climax.text: Build genuine relationships with assistants, office managers, and support staff. They shape more than you think.

punchline.text: Respect every role. Gatekeepers remember everything.

quiz.question: Why are gatekeepers important to understand in office politics?
options: They can be manipulated easily for access
They control access, priorities, and information flow to leaders
They are responsible for office supplies
